call_points.text: Demand remains resilient on the back of GST rate rationalization and fleet replacement cycles, despite localized diesel supply concerns.
Gross margins were sustained via a 1% price hike in January and value engineering savings, offsetting commodity inflation.
Net cash position strengthened to ₹5,899 crores at the end of FY26, up over ₹1,650 crores YoY.
FY27 capex is planned between ₹750 crores and ₹1,000 crores, focusing on new products and EV/alternative powertrain technologies.

operating_notes.text: April 2026 domestic sales stood at 14,242 units (+14% YoY) while exports stood at 404 units.
Bagged an order for 715 vehicles from VRL Logistics in May 2026, including AVTR 3120 haulage trucks, BOSS 1615 trucks, and Oyster staff buses.
May 2026 total vehicle sales stood at 14,923 units (-4% YoY), with domestic sales at 14,148 units (-3% YoY).
FY26 total CV volumes reached an all-time high of 220,437 units.
Domestic MHCV market share was 29% in Q1FY27; LCV VAHAN market share 13.2%, up 30 bps YoY.
Switch Mobility has an e-bus order book of 2,100 units after a 650 e-bus order; OHM Mobility operates over 1,900 e-buses.
Hinduja Leyland Finance AUM grew 20% YoY to ₹60,310 Cr with PAT of ₹123 Cr; Hinduja Housing Finance AUM ₹16,157 Cr with PAT of ₹69 Cr.

timeline.summary: Ashok Leyland reported April 2026 total sales of 14,646 units, up 9% YoY.
Ashok Leyland secured an order for 715 vehicles from VRL Logistics, with 300 units already delivered.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹17,246.44 Cr (+17.4% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹1,290.7 Cr (+14.2% YoY).
On May 28, 2026, Ashok Leyland approved in-principle the issuance of NCDs aggregating up to ₹300 Cr on a private placement basis.
Ashok Leyland scheduled its 77th Annual General Meeting for August 14, 2026.
Ashok Leyland approved the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary in Indonesia on May 28, 2026.
Ashok Leyland reported May 2026 total vehicle sales of 14,923 units, down 4% YoY.
Ashok Leyland received credit rating reaffirmations and a new assignment totaling ₹7,479.38 Cr from ICRA on June 2, 2026.
On May 28, 2026, Ashok Leyland reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹14,161 Cr up 19% YoY, achieving record full-year FY26 performance with revenue of ₹44,007 Cr and net cash of ₹5,899 Cr.

Ashok Leyland's Q1FY27 call (Aug 14, 2026) reported record Q1 revenue of ₹9,634 Cr (+10% YoY) but flat EBITDA of ₹970 Cr as commodity costs rose; management guided Q2 as the cost peak with relief from Q3.
